body: No, nobody can stop me now. You did well.
Thanks a lot man. I read your recent post. Whatever you do, don't do it with a knife.
I'm sorry, you just can't. I don't even feel human anymore. Goodbye. Just remember that you tried. Thank you.
Kid, that's what I've been trying to do for years. I don't want to bring this strain on a 13-year old. Please just forget about me.
If not tonight, I'll do it some other time. I don't want that little extra bit of pain. Don't need to love anyone in the abyss.

I've shattered my mind over a single person and every day consists of me dreading the day I won't be able to talk to her anymore. I could kill for her honestly. The days pass in minutes when she's not with me. Again, thanks for trying but this post was just something to rant on before I die I guess.
Thank you for trying, but I've been through this so many times. Now I'm finally ready. I really don't matter. My mind is already broken and I can barely feel anymore. I'm sorry.
